heading: Meet our team
intro: Different strengths. Shared curiosity. Meet the roles behind the StatSoc community.

roles.title: President
roles.description: Brings the team together and helps shape the society’s direction.

roles.title: Vice President
roles.description: Supports the president and helps the executive team turn ideas into action.

roles.title: Treasurer
roles.description: Looks after budgets and helps the society make the most of its resources.

roles.title: Secretary
roles.description: Keeps communication, records and society administration organised.

roles.title: Event Directors
roles.description: Plans experiences that bring our statistics community together.

roles.title: Brand Director
roles.description: Shapes our visual identity and shares the stories behind the society.
